mentions.name: C Swiss Tables library
mentions.description: A small C library implementing Go's Swiss Tables hash map, allowing any byte array to be used as a key, such as a C string, a number, or a bool.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm writing a small C library to use them for fun, so you can use any byte array as a key. Either a C string, a number, a bool, etc.
mentions.author: program
